title: Perfect inverse-limit reconstruction over an adically complete ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal, with $A\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A/I^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Given objects $K_n\in D(A/I^n)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and maps $K_{n+1}\to K_n$ in $D(A/I^{n+1})$ inducing isomorphisms $K_{n+1}\otimes^L_{A/I^{n+1}}A/I^n\simeq K_n$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], suppose $K_1$ is perfect, meaning isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Then $K=R\varprojlim_n K_n$ [def-weil-derived-limit] is perfect and derived $I$-complete in $D(A)$ [def-weil-point-derived-complete-module-complex], and the canonical maps $K\otimes_A^L A/I^n\to K_n$ are isomorphisms compatible with the transitions.
